_comment: THE pricing seed: the only place in the repo where a SortMyCover price is typed (3.6). Loaded into the Postgres `pricing` table by `node automation/billing/pricing.js --sql`. Every other surface reads the table. VAT)' column as written, matching media-buyer's campaign-spec; whether Meta's budget should be that figure or that figure / 1.15 (Meta adds VAT on top) is needs_human NH-BA-03. ref_code is the one-letter tier token used in payment references (needs_human NH-BA-02).
